text: Alain Stanké (né Aloyzas-Vytas Stankevicius), CM CQ (born June 11, 1934), is a Canadian francophone television and radio host, commentator, writer, editor, producer, interviewer, and journalist.[1] He was born in Kaunas, Lithuania, and moved to Montreal in 1951. In 1998, he was appointed a Member of the Order of Canada for his role as a "multi-talented individual, who has both entertained and challenged us throughout his career."[1] In 2003, he was awarded a Knight of the National Order of Quebec.[2] This Quebec biographical article is a stub.
